intro: Two pieces of cucur udang have an estimated 200 kcal. Most of the calories come from the flour batter and frying oil.
diet: Yes, but don't make it your main meal. There's very little protein from the prawns. It's mostly flour and oil. Two pieces as a snack is still okay. Add another protein source so you don't get hungry fast.
tips: Pick chilli sauce, not peanut sauce, to save calories.
Share with friends if you buy a whole pack.
If you make it at home, add more taugeh and prawns, less flour.

swap.name: Small plate of boiled prawns or tauhu bakar
swap.why: More protein and less oil, so it's more filling.

faq.q: Why does my cucur udang turn soft?
faq.a: Usually the oil isn't hot enough or the batter is too runny. Add a bit of rice flour for crispiness.

faq.q: What's the best dip for cucur udang?
faq.a: Chilli sauce or peanut sauce are the most popular. Up north, many like it with spicy kuah kacang.
Yes, the flavour is stronger. Just use less salt because dried prawns are already salty.
